neighbours.label: a prize or award as the thing being conferred (subject of 'is awarded/was given/is presented'), in prize-giving text; the - pole is someone having 'won' it
fire: Every spring the prize is awarded to a first-time novelist under thirty.

Since 1950 the medal has been given to more than eighty scientists.

notes: Card: ' prize', ' award', ' awarded' in ceremony and prize history text; - pole peaks on ' won'. Probe: 'the prize was given to' 0.84, 'won the prize' 0.07, 'received the award' 0.03.
